   465	/**
   466	 * Get handoff status for Project Manager (§13.1)
   467	 *
   468	 * Priority-ordered algorithm:
   469	 * 1. Non-dependency blockers (decision/external/technical) → IN_PROGRESS (PM must act)
   470	 * 2. READY WPs → route to assigned agent via readyStatusForAgent
   471	 * 2b. IN_PROGRESS WPs with a pending pipeline stage → route to the stage-owning agent.
   472	 *     Covers stage-transition routing (e.g. impl PASS → QA) and freshly-claimed WPs
   473	 *     (zero pipelines → route to first active stage). Guards: FAIL (break), current-stage
   474	 *     IN_PROGRESS (break), upstream IN_PROGRESS (break).
   475	 * 3. All terminal → READY_FOR_SYNTHESIS
   476	 * 4. WPs in-flight (IN_PROGRESS or dependency-BLOCKED) → WAIT
   477	 */
   478	export async function getProjectManagerHandoff(wpDetails: WorkPackageDetail[], projectPath?: string, store?: LedgerStore) {
   479	  // Step 1: Non-dependency blockers — PM must resolve before work can continue.
   480	  // Dependency-blocked WPs (blocked_by absent or blocked_by.type === 'dependency') are
   481	  // skipped — they are gated on other WPs completing, not on PM intervention.
   482	  for (const wp of wpDetails) {
   483	    if (
   484	      !isTerminalStatus(wp.status) &&
   485	      wp.status === 'BLOCKED' &&
   486	      wp.blocked_by != null &&
   487	      ['decision', 'external', 'technical'].includes(wp.blocked_by.type)
   488	    ) {
   489	      return buildHandoffResponse(
   490	        'Project Manager',
   491	        'IN_PROGRESS',
   492	        `Blocker resolution required: ${wp.work_package_id} is BLOCKED by a ${wp.blocked_by.type} issue — "${wp.blocked_by.description}". Project Manager must resolve before work can continue.`,
   493	        undefined,
   494	        projectPath,
   495	        store
   496	      );
   497	    }
   498	  }
   499	
   500	  // Step 2: READY WPs → route to the agent assigned to that work package.
   501	  // Unassigned WPs route to the agent owning the WP's first active stage (§13.1).
   502	  for (const wp of wpDetails) {
   503	    if (wp.status === 'READY') {
   504	      const targetAgent =
   505	        wp.assigned_to ??
   506	        PIPELINE_AGENT_MAP[
   507	          firstActiveStage(
   508	            (wp.active_pipeline_stages as PipelineType[] | undefined) ?? null
   509	          )
   510	        ];
   511	      const status = readyStatusForAgent(targetAgent);
   512	      return buildHandoffResponse(
   513	        'Project Manager',
   514	        status,
   515	        `Work package ${wp.work_package_id} is READY. Routing to ${targetAgent} (${wp.assigned_to ? 'assigned' : 'first active stage'}).`,
   516	        undefined,
   517	        projectPath,
   518	        store
   519	      );
   520	    }
   521	  }
   522	
   523	  // Step 2b: IN_PROGRESS WPs needing next pipeline stage (§13.1 step 2b)
   524	  // Fires only when step 2 finds no READY WPs. Scans each non-terminal, non-dependency-blocked
   525	  // IN_PROGRESS WP for a pipeline stage that has not yet PASSed and is safe to start.
   526	  // Covers both (a) stage-transition routing and (b) freshly-claimed WPs with zero pipelines.
   527	  for (const wp of wpDetails) {
   528	    if (isTerminalStatus(wp.status) || wp.status !== 'IN_PROGRESS') continue;
   529	    if (isBlockedByDependencies(wp)) continue;
   530	
   531	    const activeStages = getOrderedActiveStages(
   532	      (wp.active_pipeline_stages as PipelineType[] | undefined) ?? [...DEFAULT_PIPELINE_STAGES]
   533	    );
   534	
   535	    for (const stage of activeStages) {
   536	      // Check the most recent non-auto-cancelled pipeline for this stage
   537	      const mostRecent = latestNonCancelledPipeline(wp.pipelines, stage);
   538	
   539	      if (mostRecent?.status === 'PASS') continue; // stage done, check next
   540	
   541	      // First stage not yet PASS — apply guards before routing
   542	      if (mostRecent?.status === 'FAIL') break; // FAIL routing handled by downstream agent's own handoff
   543	      if (mostRecent?.status === 'IN_PROGRESS') break; // stage already being worked on
   544	
   545	      // Upstream prerequisite guard: skip if upstream stage is still IN_PROGRESS
   546	      const upstream = resolvePrerequisite(stage, activeStages);
   547	      if (upstream) {
   548	        if (latestNonCancelledPipeline(wp.pipelines, upstream)?.status === 'IN_PROGRESS') break;
   549	      }
   550	
   551	      // Route to the agent that owns this stage
   552	      const targetAgent = PIPELINE_AGENT_MAP[stage];
   553	      const status = readyStatusForAgent(targetAgent);
   554	      return buildHandoffResponse(
   555	        'Project Manager',
   556	        status,
   557	        `Work package ${wp.work_package_id} is IN_PROGRESS with ` +
   558	          `${stage} stage pending. Routing to ${targetAgent}.`,
   559	        undefined,
   560	        projectPath,
   561	        store
   562	      );
   563	    }
   564	  }
   565	
   566	  // Step 3: All terminal → Synthesis.
   567	  if (wpDetails.length > 0 && wpDetails.every((wp) => isTerminalStatus(wp.status))) {
   568	    return buildHandoffResponse(
   569	      'Project Manager',
   570	      'READY_FOR_SYNTHESIS',
   571	      'All work packages are in a terminal state. Project ready for Synthesis.',
   572	      undefined,
   573	      projectPath,
   574	      store
   575	    );
   576	  }
   577	
   578	  // Step 4: WPs in-flight (IN_PROGRESS or dependency-BLOCKED) — no PM action needed.
   579	  return buildHandoffResponse(
   580	    'Project Manager',
   581	    'WAIT',
   582	    'Work packages are in-flight (IN_PROGRESS or BLOCKED by dependencies). No Project Manager action needed.',
   583	    undefined,
   584	    projectPath,
   585	    store
   586	  );
   587	}
   588	
   589	/**
   590	 * Get handoff status for Developer (§5.1)
   591	 *
   592	 * Priority-ordered algorithm:
   593	 * 1. Temporal-guarded FAIL check — only trigger rework when downstream has ALREADY
   594	 *    re-engaged since the most recent implementation PASS (prevents false rework loops
   595	 *    when Developer has re-delivered but downstream has not yet started).
   596	 * 2. All non-BLOCKED WPs have PASS impl → READY_FOR_QA.
   597	 * 3. Non-BLOCKED WPs still need implementation or have impl FAIL → IN_PROGRESS.
   598	 * 4. All WPs terminal → READY_FOR_SYNTHESIS.
   599	 * Fallback → READY_FOR_QA (partial-complete case).
   600	 */
   601	export async function getDeveloperHandoff(wpDetails: WorkPackageDetail[], projectPath?: string, store?: LedgerStore) {
   602	  // Early exit: all WPs terminal → READY_FOR_SYNTHESIS (§5.1 step 3).
   603	  // Must be checked BEFORE allImplemented to avoid false positives on CANCELLED WPs
   604	  // that have no impl pipeline.
   605	  if (wpDetails.length > 0 && wpDetails.every((wp) => isTerminalStatus(wp.status))) {
   606	    return buildHandoffResponse(
   607	      'Developer',
   608	      'READY_FOR_SYNTHESIS',
   609	      'All work packages are in a terminal state (COMPLETE or CANCELLED).',
   610	      undefined,
   611	      projectPath,
   612	      store
   613	    );
   614	  }
   615	
   616	  // Scope filter (§13.1 §21.69): only WPs that include 'implementation' in their active
   617	  // stages are subject to pipeline-specific checks. Legacy WPs without the field fall
   618	  // back to DEFAULT_PIPELINE_STAGES (backward-compatible).
   619	  const implWps = scopeToStage(wpDetails, 'implementation');
   620	
   621	  // Step 1 of §5.1: Temporal-guarded FAIL check.
   622	  // Fire IN_PROGRESS only when a downstream agent has ALREADY started work after our
   623	  // most recent implementation PASS. This prevents false rework loops: if Developer
   624	  // has re-delivered (impl-2 PASS) but QA has not yet started, hasDownstreamReengagedSince
   625	  // returns false and we fall through to READY_FOR_QA instead of re-triggering rework.
   626	  const activeWps = implWps.filter(
   627	    (wp) => !isTerminalStatus(wp.status) && !isBlockedByDependencies(wp)
   628	  );
   629	  const failTypes = ['implementation', 'qa', 'code-review'] as const;
   630	  for (const wp of activeWps) {
   631	    for (const type of failTypes) {
   632	      if (
   633	        isMostRecentPipelineFail(wp.pipelines, type) &&
   634	        hasDownstreamReengagedSince(wp.pipelines, 'implementation')
   635	      ) {
   636	        const wpsNeedingRework = activeWps.filter((w) =>
   637	          failTypes.some(
   638	            (t) =>
   639	              isMostRecentPipelineFail(w.pipelines, t) &&
   640	              hasDownstreamReengagedSince(w.pipelines, 'implementation')
   641	          )
   642	        );
   643	        return buildHandoffResponse(
   644	          'Developer',
   645	          'IN_PROGRESS',
   646	          `Implementation work in progress. ${wpsNeedingRework.length} work package(s) have downstream failures requiring rework (downstream re-engaged after last implementation PASS).`,
   647	          `Call ledger_get_next_action with agent_role: "Developer" to find the next work package to implement or rework. Continue working until all WPs have PASS implementation pipelines.`,
   648	          projectPath,
   649	          store
   650	        );

   887	export async function getSecurityAuditorHandoff(wpDetails: WorkPackageDetail[], projectPath?: string, store?: LedgerStore) {

   931	  );
